hints.tr: `forced != stock` her satır için `True` / `False` veriyor; `True` olanlar bozulan değerler.
hints.en: `forced != stock` gives `True` / `False` per row; the `True` ones are the values that broke.

hints.tr: Asıl değerler için maskeyi asıl seriye uygula: `stock[broken]`.
hints.en: For the original values apply the mask to the original series: `stock[broken]`.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
import pandas as pd

stock = pd.Series([90, 120, 250, 300, 40])

forced = stock.astype("int8")
print(forced.tolist())

broken = forced != stock
print(int(broken.sum()))
print(stock[broken].tolist())

safe = pd.to_numeric(stock, downcast="integer")
print(safe.dtype, safe.tolist())
```

The full solution:

```python
import pandas as pd

stock = pd.Series([90, 120, 250, 300, 40])

forced = stock.astype("int8")
print(forced.tolist())

broken = forced != stock
print(int(broken.sum()))
print(stock[broken].tolist())

safe = pd.to_numeric(stock, downcast="integer")
print(safe.dtype, safe.tolist())
```
